capabilities.description: WebdriverIO test-only permissions. Defined inline here, not as a `capabilities/e2e.json` file, because Tauri's build-time capability validation checks every file under `capabilities/` against the plugins actually compiled in — a standalone file would fail that check on every normal (non-e2e) build, since tauri-plugin-wdio/-webdriver are only linked with `--features e2e`. This override is only ever merged in via `tauri.e2e.conf.json`, so it's the only place these permissions are ever evaluated.
